cost_model.basis: single vCPU-second of general-purpose cloud compute, billed by the second
cost_model.source: AWS EC2 on-demand c7g.large us-east-1 list price, halved to one vCPU ($0.0723/hr for 2 vCPU); recorded as an assumption, not a negotiated rate

dataset.name: support-ticket-routing
dataset.provenance: Synthetic. Generated deterministically by app.benchmarks.datasets.support_ticket_routing.generate at seed 20260830, generator version 3.0.0. Not sampled from production support traffic.

latency_definition: Wall-clock nanoseconds around a single-example predict() call, measured with time.perf_counter_ns() in-process after a warm-up pass. Reported as the median (p50) and 95th percentile over the evaluation split. Model setup and training time are excluded.
limitations: The dataset is synthetic, so difficulty reflects its generator rather than production support traffic.
Only rules and traditional ML are implemented; no small-model or frontier-LLM result exists for this problem.
Cost is projected from measured latency and a published compute rate, not from a billed invoice.
metric_definition: accuracy = exact-match of predicted label against the gold label, micro-averaged over every example in the evaluation split; macro_f1 = unweighted mean of per-class F1.
notes: Scores each queue by keyword hits; ties resolve by triage priority. Every routing decision is explainable from the matched terms.
